title: Higher-image transition identity
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $h:Y\to S$ a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Write $t(a)$ for the canonical higher-image transition [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions] for a commutative triangle. Write $P_h(F)=H^q(Rh_*F[0])$. If $e_Y:(id_Y)^*\simeq id$ is the identity pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], then $t(id_Y)\,P_h(e_Y(F))=id_{P_h(F)}$.

source.place: Tags 09Z1 and 03Q8, canonical comparisons; formal adjunction calculation for these comparisons

proof.text: Expand the transition before taking homology. The inverse-image composition comparison for `id ≫ h = h` is the inverse of the identity comparison whiskered by `h^*`. Move this comparison past the counit by naturality, and cancel the unit and counit of `h^* ⊣ Rh_*` by the triangle identity. The comparison between derived identity pullback and identity, followed by the single-functor comparison and the single-functor image of the sheaf identity comparison, is the identity. This follows by applying the defining factorization of the exact derived functor to the complex concentrated in degree zero. Thus the entire derived morphism is the identity. Apply degree-q homology, which preserves identities. The generic source-library derived pullback identity and associativity comparisons apply to ModuleCat coefficients; the abelian-group-only derivedInverseImageComposition theorem is not used.

theorem higher_direct_image_transition_identity
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {S Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ S)
    (q : ℤ) (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    higherDirectImageTransition Λ (𝟙 Y) h h (Category.id_comp h) q F ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ q).map
        (R+((h)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
            ((upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Y).hom.app F))) = 𝟙 _
